title: Bar Drop Cola Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Cola Ice by Drop offers the quintessential taste of a chilled soda. The inhale delivers the sugary, caramel-spice profile of traditional cola, accurate to the fizzy drink favorite. The experience is completed by a crisp blast of ice menthol on the exhale, simulating the sensation of a cold drink poured over ice cubes. This e-liquid features a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, which enhances the "fizz" sensation and ensures the cola spices are sharp and distinct. Optimised for low-powered MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) devices, the nicotine salt blend offers a smooth throat hit in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Manufactured by UK brand Drop, Bar Drop Salts range of nic salt e-liquids focus on fruity flavours that are endlessly popular as well as a few unique profiles you won’t find anywhere else.
